summary: Backend + Frontend testing of Clelia & Co. Design Studio v2 (direct-entry shell with OpenAI streaming guidance). Backend: 6/6 pytest passed - /api/health, /api/design-guidance/stream (200 status, text/event-stream, real OpenAI tokens streamed, `event: done` received, ~1KB of guidance in <20s, no API key leakage), 422 validation for short session_id, 401 for invalid customer/staff login, and unauthenticated /api/designs rejected. Frontend at /?type=ring: shell loads with tool-header, 6-step progress (Step 1 of 6) and Ring pre-selected via query param; first-visit overlay renders with 4 concise steps and closes via Begin; Help button replays the overlay; header logo and footer link both point to https://cleliaandco.com; no old marketing hero present; /login renders customer form; /staff/login exposes authenticator/code hint; mobile 390px shows no horizontal overflow. CRITICAL BUG: step 2 -> step 3 transition is missing from moveForward() in DesignStudioPage.jsx, so pressing Continue on the description step with valid content does nothing (user is stuck on step 2). This blocks the entire customer flow (steps 3-6, including OpenAI generation) from being reachable through the UI, even though the underlying streaming endpoint is fully functional (verified end-to-end via curl and pytest).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing setStep(3) branch for step === 2. When description passes the >=12 char validation on step 2 (Describe), the Continue button does nothing - the function falls through past the step 3/4/5 branches to the returnUrl fallback, which is undefined. Result: user is permanently stuck on step 2 and cannot reach the metal selector, Create-my-design action, OpenAI streaming, review, or confirmation. Fix: add `if (step === 2) return setStep(3);` right after the description-length validation block.

On step 1 mobile viewport, both the selected Ring card AND the Earrings card render with the plum (dark) background. Only Ring shows the checkmark. Looks like an nth-child(even) alternating style is applied on top of .is-selected, causing an unselected card to visually appear selected. Confusing to users.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend never calls setStep(3), so the OpenAI /api/design-guidance/stream integration is unreachable through the UI even though the endpoint itself streams correctly (verified: 200 OK, event-stream, ~130 tokens, event: done). Fix the missing transition to unblock the full flow.

issues: Earrings tile appears plum/selected alongside actual Ring selection (likely alternating-row background bleeding through .is-selected)

action_items: CRITICAL: In /app/frontend/src/pages/DesignStudioPage.jsx moveForward(), add `if (step === 2) return setStep(3);` right after the description-length validation. Without this, the whole customer flow is blocked and OpenAI guidance never runs from the UI.
Investigate alternating type-card background on mobile so that only the currently selected type shows the plum fill.
critical_code_review_comments: moveForward() is a switch-like ladder implemented with sequential ifs and no default step->step+1 fallback - hence the missing step-2 branch went unnoticed. Consider `setStep(step + 1)` as a default at the bottom and only override for special cases (step 4 streaming, step 6 confirm).

SSE parsing in the frontend uses chunk.split('\n\n') then part.replace('data: ', '') on each part. If a chunk boundary splits mid-record, the trailing partial line is silently discarded because it will not have a `data: ` prefix on the next chunk. A small buffer that accumulates partial lines across reads would be more robust.

server.py CORSMiddleware currently defaults allow_origins to '*'. That is fine while allow_credentials=False, but the .env has CORS_ORIGINS='*' - once real auth cookies/credentials are used this will need explicit origins.

OPENAI_API_KEY is read via os.environ[...] at request time which is correct - but chat_service.stream_design_guidance rebuilds an LlmChat per call; acceptable for now but consider a lazy singleton if traffic grows.

Frontend passes crypto.randomUUID() as session_id every call, so backend cannot correlate the customer's turns in db.design_guidance_messages. If chat memory is desired, session_id should persist across the same designer session.

rca_of_the_issue: moveForward() handles steps 1, 3, 4, 5 explicitly but omits the setStep(3) call for step 2. After validating the description length, control drops through to the returnUrl fallback which no-ops when no return_url query param is set. Reproduce: open /?type=ring, close overlay, Continue, choose an example idea, Continue -> nothing happens, step 2 remains visible. Mitigation: add `if (step === 2) return setStep(3);` after the description validation block.
